T0555.title: Payment Tokenization
T0555.definition: A payment protection technique that replaces sensitive card or account data with a tokenized substitute.
T0555.description: Payment tokenization replaces sensitive card or account data with tokens so merchants and business systems do not hold clear payment data. Reviews should cover token scope, mapping-vault protection, masked display, transaction binding, and abnormal revocation so tokens do not become long-lived reusable credentials.
T0555.usageExample: Assess Payment Tokenization related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
